feraterra.description: Zero-install remote Streamable HTTP MCP server for FeraTerra (Arena Exchange): inspect Spot, Perpetual, FormulaPerp, BoundedClaim, and SpreadBook L2/L3 orderbooks, OHLCV candles, Gladiator Leaderboard standings, stateless POST /order/preview margin simulations, and ECDSA ledger-tip solvency proofs. Public read-only access with no API key required.
